theorems.name: Submission.allard52_gpa_graph_normal_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) (x : Rn n) (y : Rn ℓ), ‖A‖ ≤ 1 → ‖y - A x‖ ≤ 2 * ‖q (graphPoint x y) - ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (A v))).map q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap).starProjection (q (graphPoint x y))‖
